dispatch_rule: Do not create task 11 until one of these ten materially closes, falsifies, or unblocks a project.

tasks.objective: Recover trustworthy real-host DB, queue, worker and failure state before creating new work.
tasks.evidence_requirement: Existing SQLite/WAL/process state, integrity result, backup hash, task counts, leases, heartbeats, PIDs/commands and provider/resource state; preserve failed runs.
tasks.verification_method: Independent SQLite recount plus process inspection; distinguish logical identities, shell-only processes and active workers.
tasks.success_criterion: Real counters and integrity/recovery truth measured.
tasks.failure_criterion: Unavailable/unrecoverable host remains BLOCKED_EXTERNAL; no large queue is created.

tasks.objective: Certify exact served production revision and then the authenticated golden journey on that revision.
tasks.deliverable: Exact-SHA health artifact plus authenticated journey evidence
tasks.evidence_requirement: Deployment identity, intended SHA, live health response, journey step results and denial checks.
tasks.verification_method: Canonical public monitor plus disposable authenticated account; source/Vercel status alone is insufficient.
tasks.success_criterion: Exact revision, public boundaries and authenticated journey pass.
tasks.failure_criterion: Revision mismatch/missing or journey failure keeps production non-GREEN.

tasks.objective: Close remaining provenance gaps without new scientific training.
tasks.dependency: Frozen retained ARC artifacts and PROVENANCE_MATRIX.md
tasks.deliverable: Exact matched-supervised and bounded-DeBERTa artifact identities plus deterministic figure-source and environment manifests
tasks.evidence_requirement: Every release number traces to retained raw data, protocol and source.
tasks.verification_method: Independent recomputation and hash checks; unresolved evidence is removed or RED-marked.
tasks.success_criterion: All intended quantitative tables/figures have complete provenance.
tasks.failure_criterion: Missing retained artifact blocks affected display; no result recreation by rescue run.

tasks.objective: Make paper figures/tables mechanically reproducible from frozen evidence.
tasks.deliverable: Deterministic primary-result, mechanism-effect and reproducibility display scripts plus one regeneration command
tasks.evidence_requirement: Checksum-addressed source data only; no decorative or inferred results.
tasks.verification_method: Fresh execution reproduces generated files/hashes within declared boundaries.
tasks.success_criterion: Manuscript displays regenerate from retained evidence.
tasks.failure_criterion: Manual result editing leaves paper package YELLOW.

tasks.objective: Implement and execute the selected real-encoder development diagnostic exactly under REAL_ENCODER_PROTOCOL_V1.md.
tasks.dependency: Environment can load pinned XLM-R revision and frozen XNLI revision
tasks.deliverable: Implementation, resolved resource hashes, selected indices, raw embedding checksums, transforms, probes, predictions, bootstrap metrics, gate verdict and verifier
tasks.evidence_requirement: One encoder, six fixed languages, development split only until G0/G1 pass, all controls preserved.
tasks.verification_method: Independent metric recomputation and protocol verifier; XNLI test stays locked unless G0/G1 pass.
tasks.success_criterion: Record PASS or FAIL exactly against frozen gates.
tasks.failure_criterion: Pinned resources unavailable becomes BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_RESOURCE; no friendlier substitution.

tasks.objective: Freeze the dangerous same-model direct-vs-typed-IR comparator amendment.
tasks.dependency: Actual accessible model/provider identity plus a newly authored frozen benchmark
tasks.deliverable: Protocol amendment fixing model/revision, prompts, decoding, retries, call/token budget, benchmark hash, practical effect threshold, uncertainty and cost ceiling
tasks.evidence_requirement: M1 and B1 use the same model/provider/task budget where feasible.
tasks.verification_method: Protocol committed before any benchmark outputs are observed.
tasks.failure_criterion: No fair/stable comparator keeps NeuroCAD bounded; weak baseline is not substituted.

tasks.objective: Define a genuinely generic v2 typed CAD mechanism before structural OOD.
tasks.dependency: Current plate-specific v1 source; no held-out OOD execution
tasks.deliverable: Reusable primitive/feature/constraint/composition/reference/validation/compiler design plus development/validation/held-out family policy
tasks.evidence_requirement: No one-regex-branch-per-test-family design; held-out cases cannot guide patches.
tasks.verification_method: Reviewer can distinguish generic primitives from family-specific templates.
tasks.success_criterion: v2 mechanism is precise enough to implement and falsify.
tasks.failure_criterion: Hard-coded family templates archive the broad research claim while preserving v1 software value.

tasks.objective: Convert the reproduced robustness-adaptation tradeoff into a negative/mixed manuscript package without successor rescue.
tasks.deliverable: Evidence-backed manuscript, figure/table provenance, limitations, failure taxonomy and originality audit
tasks.evidence_requirement: Preserve scalar heavy-tail gains, abrupt failure, learned-transfer failure, strong baseline tradeoffs and locked confirmatory seeds.
tasks.verification_method: Every result traces to recovered archive/hash; no external result invented.
tasks.success_criterion: Defensible technical-report/workshop candidate or explicit archive decision.
tasks.failure_criterion: Weak novelty downgrades to technical negative report rather than rescue experiments.
tasks.canonical_artifact_destination: IRIS manuscript/evidence package in control repo

tasks.objective: Recover original scientific source/config/checkpoint before any new NPMS experiment.
tasks.dependency: Access to retained NPMS source/config/checkpoint archive if it exists
tasks.deliverable: Canonical provenance map plus clean rerun or precise SOURCE_UNRECOVERED verdict
tasks.evidence_requirement: Preserve known spectral/switching/truncation failures; recovery validator is not original-source evidence.
tasks.verification_method: Hashes plus fresh command/result comparison if source is recovered.
tasks.success_criterion: NPMS obtains a real source identity for later experimentation.
tasks.failure_criterion: Unrecovered source archives current line as recovered compact evidence only.

tasks.objective: Package only internally complete claims for bounded non-author tests.
tasks.deliverable: Immutable artifact/version plus one precise validator request per eligible claim
tasks.evidence_requirement: Sent-version hash, requested action and returned evidence when available.
tasks.verification_method: Outreach/pending review remains BLOCKED_EXTERNAL; no GREEN on send.
tasks.success_criterion: Independent evidence received and recorded with success/failure interpretation.
tasks.failure_criterion: Disagreement/non-reproduction narrows or blocks claim and is preserved.
